# Orochia

> Orochia is an open-source (Apache-2.0), adult-friendly video platform for independent creators,
> made by Krizaka (Montréal). Creators publish 4K videos and decide exactly who watches each one;
> viewers follow, comment, like, share, tip and unlock. Every playback link is signed for five
> minutes, payments are confirmed by the payment gateway and settled exactly once into a
> double-entry ledger, and creators are verified under 18 U.S.C. § 2257 before they upload.
> Adults only (18+).

## What creators can do

- Choose who watches each video: everyone, approved followers, contacts, people who tipped to
  unlock it (with a minimum the creator sets), or an invited audience — people invited one by one
  or reusable audience lists ("Close friends") that stay private.
- Organise videos into collections, each opened to everyone, followers, contacts, invited people
  or lists, or kept private. A collection never opens a video its own rule keeps closed.
- Earn tips and paid unlocks through adult-friendly gateways (CCBill, Segpay, crypto via
  NOWPayments); balances are read from an immutable ledger; request payouts.
- See views (counted once per viewer and day), likes, comments and shares; moderate or close
  comments.

## Key pages

- Home and feed: https://orochia.com/
- Explore (search creators, videos, tags): https://orochia.com/explore
- Creator pages: https://orochia.com/creators/{username}
- Legal: https://orochia.com/legal/terms · https://orochia.com/legal/privacy ·
  https://orochia.com/legal/2257 · https://orochia.com/legal/dmca

## For developers and operators

- Source code: https://github.com/krizaka/orochia (web app and API, Next.js + PostgreSQL),
  https://github.com/krizaka/orochia-admin (operator console),
  https://github.com/krizaka/orochia-design-system
- Documentation (architecture, API contracts, database, deployment):
  https://krizaka.com/en/products/orochia/docs
- Product overview: https://krizaka.com/en/products/orochia
- Self-hostable: Docker Compose or DigitalOcean App Platform; Bunny Stream for video delivery.
